Microsoft Excel Study Notes

Preview · Pages 1–5 unlocked
Open the original PDF preview (8 pages) →
Chapter 1
Excel Basics (Interface, Cells, Workbooks & Data Entry)

The Excel screen, the Ribbon and Formula Bar, what a cell/row/column/worksheet/workbook is, and how to enter, edit and save data.

Chapter 2
SUM Function

Adding numbers across a range, multiple ranges or individual cells with =SUM(), AutoSum, and avoiding common totalling mistakes.

Chapter 3
AVERAGE Function

Calculating the mean of a data set with =AVERAGE(), how blanks and text are handled, and combining it with ROUND for clean results.

Chapter 4
MIN & MAX Functions

Instantly finding the smallest and largest values in a range, e.g. topper/lowest marks or highest/lowest sales, plus LARGE/SMALL for ranked values.

Chapter 5
COUNT Functions (COUNT, COUNTA, COUNTBLANK)

Counting numeric entries, all filled entries, and empty cells — useful for checking data completeness before totals or averages.
